lines.text: Find the shortest way. Get all 3 gems in 11 moves or less.
Get all 2 gems using only 5 cards. A Repeat card does the cards inside it again and again. Tap the number to pick how many times.
Get all 3 gems using only 3 cards. A Repeat card does the cards inside it again and again. Tap the number to pick how many times.
Get all 3 gems with 11 cards or fewer. Fewer cards earn more stars. 7 cards earns three stars.
Here is one way. Press Go to watch it.
Put some moves in the Stamp box once. Then play the Stamp with a Stamp card, turn, and play it again. Only 8 cards.
Tap the arrow cards to plan a path for the robot. Get all 2 gems, then press Go.
Tap the arrow cards to plan a path for the robot. Get all 3 gems, then press Go.
Tap the arrow cards to plan a path for the robot. Get the gem, then press Go.
The Stamp cannot use itself. Tap outside the Stamp box first.
This path is long. A While card keeps going while gems are left. Inside it, turn at a wall, else go forward. Only 4 cards.
